title: Extended Knuth conjecture for joint arc-count distributions in random digraph depth-first search
statement:
Consider a random multidigraph on $n$ vertices in which the outdegree of each vertex is independently distributed as $\operatorname{Ge}(1-p)$, with $p\in(0,1)$, and endpoints of outgoing arcs chosen independently and uniformly from the $n$ vertices. In a Depth-First Search, let $L,F,B,C,T$ denote the counts of the corresponding arc types used in the paper. **Extended Knuth conjecture.** For every $n\geqslant1$ and every $p\in(0,1)$,

$$
(L,F,B+C,T)\overset{\mathrm{d}}{=}(L,B,F+C,T).
$$

This strengthens Knuth's equality in distribution by asserting a joint symmetry involving the other arc counts. It is presented as a conjecture and no resolution is supplied in the source.
source_name: Svante Janson, “On Knuth's conjecture for back and forward arcs in Depth First Search in a random digraph with geometric outdegree distribution”, arXiv:2301.04131 (2023).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.04131

Status: **open** according to the source (as of January 2023). “Unfortunately, we have not been able so use this to prove the conjecture, which still is open, but we hope that this note will inspire others to succeed with the conjecture.”
